verification_clarity.description: clear implies proposed_subproblems must be empty and decomposition_parent_coverage must be not_applicable. needs_decomposition or unverifiable implies at least one proposed subproblem is required and decomposition_parent_coverage must be complete or partial; those subproblems enter the persistent topic queue so a later campaign can pose them. These conditional rules are enforced by pipeline validation, not by this schema.

verification_standard.description: Checks whether a submission answers the source-faithful question. It may branch by answer type but must not impose artificial restrictions on the problem statement.

decomposition_parent_coverage.description: complete only when source-supported component children collectively cover the parent; partial retains the parent; not_applicable when no decomposition is proposed (required when verification_clarity is clear; complete or partial required when clarity is needs_decomposition or unverifiable, enforced by pipeline validation).

proposed_subproblems.description: Required (at least one) when verification_clarity is needs_decomposition or unverifiable; must be empty when verification_clarity is clear. Every proposed subproblem enters the persistent topic queue (topic-queue.jsonl) and is replayed as a derived-subproblem source record in a later campaign. unverifiable is therefore not a terminal verdict: the candidate must still be decomposed into more specific queued subproblems. This conditional rule is enforced by pipeline validation, not by this schema.

verification_difficulty.description: Residual verification burden scored from 0 to 10. It is descriptive and never a publication threshold.
